style: Say in a relaxed, curious way, like a science teacher sorting evidence at a desk with a student.
lines: Temperature rose about one degree in a century. Tap Carbon dioxide, Sun, Volcanoes or Fossil fuels to line it up under temperature.
Now tap a span, like Fast rise, to ask the same record a sharper question.
The sun's axis is zoomed in. Tap From zero to see how big the change really is.
The four lines mark the biggest eruptions. Look at temperature the year after each one.
Every record has an answer on your board. Ask more, or tap Argue.
For each record, tap the claims your evidence supports.
Tap up to two of your answers to back that claim.
You and the scientists agree on none of the records.
You and the scientists agree on 1 of 4 records.
You and the scientists agree on 2 of 4 records.
You and the scientists agree on 3 of 4 records.
You and the scientists agree on all 4 records.
Scientists find that people caused about all of the warming since the late 1800s.
